NG1_exact_representation.statement: Modulo the already-audited anonymous-port and destination-token isomorphism used by the Scout canonical boundary representation, the fixed fields plus the 7 P/M multiplicities and 9 T-atom multiplicities reconstruct the complete mature boundary exactly.

NG2_generated_size_invariant.consequence: A generated mature node always has at least three exposed ports. The empty-support element of the earlier 128 abstract support closure is therefore not realizable by any finite J3-generated exact object.
NG2_generated_size_invariant.theorem: For a finite object built from n J3 primitives and n-1 single bridges, ports=3n-2(n-1)=n+2 while T concatenation gives |T|=n. Hence #ports=|T|+2. If A and B each satisfy it, then #ports(A*B)=pA+pB-2=(TA+2)+(TB+2)-2=TA+TB+2=|T_out|+2.

NG3_exact_mature_macro_closure.counter_formula: p_out = p_A + p_B - e_a - e_b ; T_out_counts = T_A_counts + T_B_counts
NG3_exact_mature_macro_closure.scope: Arbitrary lawful mature-mature single-bridge composition; full multiplicities and T preserved exactly, not merely support roles.
NG3_exact_mature_macro_closure.theorem: Let A,B be generated mature records with L=15,s=1,stay=0. For any lawful selected port types a,b, L_out=15 OR 15=15; s_out=min(1,1)=1; stay_out=0 AND 0=0. The two selected P/M entries are subtracted from the input multiplicity vectors and all other entries are retained; no new P/M atom is created. T_out is concatenation, so its 9-atom count vector is the sum of the two input vectors and no new T atom is created. Thus the exact output is another generated mature record in the same 16-counter grammar.

NG4_finite_control.statement: The mature binary compositor is controlled by a fixed seven-channel alphabet and 31 ordered compatible selected-type pairs. Exact state values are unbounded integer counters, but no new descriptor or atom is required.

NG5_relation_substitution_lift.selection_note: Relations containing only mature records have score 1 throughout mature-mature composition, so weakest-link selection cannot eject an output from M.
NG5_relation_substitution_lift.statement: Because M is closed under the same audited boundary compositor, all finite mature-node internal composition contexts inherit the canonical finite-algebra substitution theorem: replacing a generated mature microscopic composite by its complete boundary relation changes no later bridge behavior or selected output relation, modulo interface isomorphism.

NG6_local_reusability.guardrail: This earns an internal algebraic node TYPE only. Ordinary composition merges two inputs into one macro; it is not yet an inter-node edge law that preserves two distinct node instances.
NG6_local_reusability.instance_independence: Any two independently instantiated copies of a mature boundary state obey the same bridge and counter-composition law.
NG6_local_reusability.membership: Generated S15 boundary interface: L=15,s=1,stay=0. The 7/9 alphabets are inherited globally from the frozen J3 constructor.
NG6_local_reusability.operation_inputs: Only the two declared boundary states and selected port types; no level, ancestry, construction history, global position, geometry, or privileged origin.
